title: Multiple treatment locations
body:
Hi,

New to GeoLift I'm using the official [walkthrough](https://facebookincubator.github.io/GeoLift/docs/GettingStarted/Walkthrough) to get used to the package.

Running the following piece of code
`    GeoTest <- GeoLift(Y_id = "Y",
                        data = GeoTestData_Test,
                        locations = c("chicago", "portland"),
                        treatment_start_time = 91,
                        treatment_end_time = 105)`

Raises the following error:
"Error in `tibble()`:
! Tibble columns must have compatible sizes.
• Size 105: Existing data.
• Size 210: Column `Yobs`.
ℹ Only values of size one are recycled."


With following traceback:
12: stop(fallback)
11: signal_abort(cnd, .file)
10: abort(x, class, ..., call = call, parent = parent, use_cli_format = TRUE)
9: tibble_abort(call = call, bullets("Tibble columns must have compatible sizes:", 
       if (!is.null(.rows)) paste0("Size ", .rows, ": ", rows_source), 
       problems, info = "Only values of size one are recycled."))
8: abort_incompatible_size(n, name, size, "Existing data", call)
7: vectbl_recycle_rows(res, first_size, j, given_col_names[[j]], 
       call)
6: tibble_quos(xs, .rows, .name_repair)
5: tibble(time = as.numeric(colnames(df)), Yobs = as.numeric(treated_unit), 
       Yhat = as.numeric(synth_unit), raw_average = as.numeric(average_unit))
4: treated_table(augsynth)
3: summary.augsynth(augsyn, alpha = alpha, stat_func = stat_func, 
       type = conformal_type, ns = ns)
2: summary(augsyn, alpha = alpha, stat_func = stat_func, type = conformal_type, 
       ns = ns)
1: GeoLift(Y_id = "Y", data = GeoTestData_Test, locations = c("chicago", 
       "portland"), treatment_start_time = 91, treatment_end_time = 105)


However, the code runs fine when only 1 location is included.

I guess this is a trivial error in data wrangling, but quite annoying.

Thanks.

PS: using GeoLift 2.7.5 and augsynth 0.2.0
